title: An old COD customer moved to Credit Hold gets $0, its limit kept in the note
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds COD and keeps a credit limit of $1,000.00 stored from before the release.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S11-09 Cash.
  • Your user name is {User-A}.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S11-09 Admin.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "COD" row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Click "Select None".
  4. Type {Customer-A}'s name in "Search customers".
  5. Tick {Customer-A}.
  6. Choose "Credit Hold" in "Move To".
  7. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  8. Click "Set Limits To $0 And Move".
  9. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
  10. Click the "Notes" tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the window opens with every COD customer ticked.
  • Step 3: "0 selected".
  • Step 4: only {Customer-A} is listed.
  • Step 5: "1 selected".
  • Step 6: the line "Their credit limit will be set to $0." shows.
  • Step 7: the confirmation "Set 1 customer's credit limit to $0?" opens.
  • Step 8: the toast "1 customer moved to Credit Hold." shows.
  • Step 9: the "Credit term" reads Credit Hold and the credit limit reads $0.00.
  • Step 10: the note reads "Credit term changed from COD to Credit Hold by {User-A} (Move Customers). Credit limit $1,000.00 → $0."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S11-R17: “If such a customer is moved to COD or Credit Hold with Move Customers, its limit becomes $0 at that moment, after the S4-R14 confirmation, and its previous limit is kept in its note (S4-R20).”
  • S4-R20: “When a move changes a customer's limit (a limit above $0 set to $0), that customer's note (S4-R11) ends with "Credit limit {old limit} → $0." A customer whose limit was already $0 or blank gets the S4-R11 note without it.”
  • S4-R14: “When "Move To" is COD or Credit Hold, pressing "Move {n} Customers" first opens a confirmation titled "Set {n} customers' credit limit to $0?" ("Set 1 customer's credit limit to $0?" for one), with the message "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move." and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Set Limits to $0 and Move" (displayed as "Set Limits To $0 And Move").”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "2 Move customers to another term", "1 List and row menus", "5 New Customer", "8 Over Credit warning" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.
